BackstoryDef.title: hatched to the line
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] emerged from the brood-warrens already assigned: this foundry, this shift, this bench. There was no question in it, and therefore no unhappiness — the line was warm, the work was endless, and the hive's hum was the only lullaby [PAWN_pronoun] ever needed.

BackstoryDef.title: winged brood
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] hatched with wings, and so hatched above. [PAWN_pronoun] was schooled in lineage, rhetoric and the administration of drones, and taught precisely one moral principle: the hive ascends when its betters are obeyed. [PAWN_pronoun] has opinions about people who work with their hands.

BackstoryDef.title: foundry artisan
BackstoryDef.description: In the great works under the rock, [PAWN_nameDef] built machines for the hive's clients — droids by the thousand, weapons by the shipload, questions by no one. [PAWN_possessive] hands hold tolerances most factories cannot, and [PAWN_pronoun] judges every made thing by one standard: would the queen's inspectors pass it.

BackstoryDef.title: siege-caller
BackstoryDef.description: The hive is the only power on this world that can sustain a siege in deep desert, and [PAWN_nameDef] is why. [PAWN_pronoun] surveyed the ground, raised the works, ranged the throwers and kept the water ledger balanced while the enemy's ran dry. Patience, to [PAWN_objective], is a weapon system.

BackstoryDef.title: hunt-detachment veteran
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served in the detachments the hive fields against sorcerers — the robed kind, who move wrong and cut through drones like paper. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to fight what cannot be predicted: swarm it, tire it, give it too many targets. [PAWN_pronoun] does not speak of the ones that got away, or of how many did.

BackstoryDef.title: design-born
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was composed before [PAWN_pronoun] was conceived — every allele argued over by a committee of curators pursuing the species as a project. [PAWN_pronoun] grew up gifted, graceful and gently reminded, daily, that [PAWN_pronoun] was a draft. Somewhere in the catalogue there is already a better version.

BackstoryDef.title: vat-decanted
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has no childhood to speak of — [PAWN_pronoun] was decanted grown, printed with just enough procedure to be useful, and put to work the same week. Everything most people absorb over twenty years, [PAWN_pronoun] is learning now, fast, out of order, and with a strange late-come wonder at all of it.

BackstoryDef.title: gene-curator
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] tended the Helix's living collection: sequencing, splicing, culling. [PAWN_pronoun] is a superb physician with one professional peculiarity — patients are specimens, and a procedure that would make another surgeon flinch is, to [PAWN_objective], simply Tuesday. The body is a rough draft. [PAWN_pronoun] edits.

BackstoryDef.title: retrieval agent
BackstoryDef.description: The Helix does not raid; it retrieves. [PAWN_nameDef] was the instrument — crossing borders quietly, finding the escaped asset or the stolen sequence, and bringing it home intact, because damaged goods reflect poorly on the handler. [PAWN_pronoun] prefers a target taken breathing and a job nobody ever hears about.

BackstoryDef.title: escaped asset
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was made by the Helix, owned by the Helix, and one night simply left — the first decision that was ever entirely [PAWN_possessive]. The catalogue lists [PAWN_objective] as a recall item, and retrieval teams do not stop. Whoever shelters [PAWN_objective] should know: [PAWN_pronoun] is excellent, and [PAWN_pronoun] is expensive to keep.

BackstoryDef.title: raised on retainer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s parent hunted people for money, and raised [PAWN_objective] between contracts on shipboard rations and rules. The rules were the point: no contract on children, no shot at a surrendered target, a debt honored is a debt dead. [PAWN_pronoun] could strip a rifle before [PAWN_pronoun] could write.

BackstoryDef.title: bounty-posted young
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was worth money dead before [PAWN_pronoun] was worth anything alive — wrong family, wrong witness, wrong world. Childhood was a sequence of exits: half-slept nights, memorized alleys, the talent of being unremarkable. [PAWN_pronoun] still sits facing the door. [PAWN_pronoun] always will.

BackstoryDef.title: named hunter
BackstoryDef.description: In the Company, most wear the armor; a few ARE the armor. [PAWN_nameDef]'s name closes cantinas by itself. [PAWN_pronoun] takes contracts, not sides; finishes what [PAWN_pronoun] signs; and extends exactly one courtesy to those who best [PAWN_objective] fairly — which is how you are still alive to read this.

BackstoryDef.title: contract broker
BackstoryDef.description: Every hunt begins as paper, and [PAWN_nameDef] wrote the paper. [PAWN_pronoun] priced targets, verified clients, held the escrow and arbitrated the disputes — the quiet law of a lawless trade. [PAWN_pronoun] can read what a person will do from what they try not to say, and prices accordingly.

BackstoryDef.title: disgraced hunter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] broke the Code — which clause, [PAWN_pronoun] will not say — and the Company posted [PAWN_possessive] own name to the boards. The skills remain; the standing is ash. [PAWN_pronoun] works twice as clean now, as if the next job done right might finally outweigh the one done wrong. It won't. [PAWN_pronoun] does it anyway.
